kitDescription: Belorta: Pumpkin Witch is a water-element rocket-launcher supporter whose entire kit buffs one specific teammate — the ally standing immediately to her right — plus one enemy debuff. Whenever the team enters Full Burst she puts on a 'Ghost Costume' (making her untargetable by single-target attacks for 10 seconds), gains a small Max HP boost, and grants the right-hand ally a flat ATK increase worth 44.88% of her own ATK. While the costume is on, each fully charged rocket she lands makes the boss take 10.56% more damage from everyone for 10 seconds; independently, every full-charge shot she fires (costumed or not) gives the right-hand ally 19.97% stronger damage-over-time effects for 5 seconds. Her own Burst II cast gives that same ally a bigger ATK grant (47.52% of her ATK) and 27.23% stronger damage-over-time for 10 seconds. She deals almost no damage herself; her value is concentrated into whoever is seated to her right, so her slot position matters enormously.

verdictRationale: All seven kit lines are FAITHFUL or DOCUMENTED_GAP and the four blind artifacts converge on every load-bearing choice: the S6 blind override is block-identical to the driver's (five blocks — same triggers, targets, gates, stats, values, durations), and both S2b reviewers' specs match the shipped encoding including the three ranked misread traps (fullBurstEnter-vs-burstCast split between skill1 and burst, no gate contamination onto the ungated 19.97 sustained line, Ghostly Prank as an enemy debuff gated on a real selfStatus rather than an fbGate proxy). The S5 convergence is mechanically RED but both red clusters classify away from the override: 8 failures are the blind file's own harness-wiring bug (onEvent at the wrong options level — empty event log), and the 3 adapted-run failures are the contested-Burst-II fixture vacuity the blind writer pre-declared as a fixture finding, with its own burstFirst probe GREEN and corroborating the burst block's shape. Discrimination holds: every load-bearing assertion runs its named nearest-wrong counterfactual in-file (S2d Arm 1 is RED with no override; Arm 2 is 23/23 green), and the fbGate-proxy blind spot flagged by S2b-1 is closed by the structure pin plus the producer-removal counterfactual. Nothing is required for GO. Same-model residuals for the owner to spot-check: (1) the S5 adapted-run numbers (11 green / 3 RED) come from the driver's notes — re-run scripts/kit-autonomy/blind/belorta-pumpkin-witch.adapted.test.ts against the shipped override to confirm; (2) every agent in the gauntlet read 'ally to the right' as slot index + 1 with no wrap-around — a shared-prior positional assumption worth one in-game screenshot (right-ally buff icon with her in slot 5 would falsify the no-wrap reading, already ⚑2 in the override); (3) the targetMaxHpPct-vs-casterMaxHpPct choice is unobservable for a self-grant and matters only if a future consumer reads the distinction.
